text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Huh?
A way to repay the fans and everyone around us...?"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...For the sake of everyone who believes in and supports me.
I was thinking about what I could do.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Fulfilling my great ambition is the ultimate way to repay them.
Even so, as the one who leads the clan, shouldn't I be showing my gratitude on a daily basis—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Fine, do you ever have doubts?
...As someone with royal blood flowing in your veins."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Rose... Yes, I understand.
Not a day goes by where I don't think about
how to properly reward my people.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Which is why... indeed.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Could you keep me company for a bit sometime? There's a place I'd love to take you♪

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhh~!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This place is...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's my favorite ramen shop! I asked the manager, and they're letting me help out just for today!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you try working here with us, Rose?
Maybe it'll help you figure out what's bothering you♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Boss! I can take this soy sauce ramen with extra green onions over, right?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Yeah, countin' on ya! Lookin' sharp and full of spirit in that outfit, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I thought customers would love this♪
Just looking at it makes the ramen look even tastier, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Dishwashing complete.
...Chef, awaiting your next instructions.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ch-Chef...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Rose, calling me that is fine too, but I think 'Boss' feels much more familiar."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Is that so? ...Then Boss, what should we do next?

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~! Sorry to bother you,
but could we get some extra plates?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right away, coming right up!
...Sorry, Rose, could you take the miso ramen to table 3, please?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, understood.
...However, regular town eateries certainly are
hectic places, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Amidst all this commotion, what could one possibly learn...?
No, for now, I must simply fulfill my duty."

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
"Ahhh, this soup hits the spot~!"
"Mmm, the best! Think I'll order some extra noodles!"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...To think it would be so full of smiles—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
...Here's your miso ramen.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yay, hooray!
Ehehe, thank you, big sis♪

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, good for you.
...After all, you won first place in the kids' race.
Let's eat plenty to celebrate, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
! A celebration...
I see. In that case, savor it to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's great!
That kid was so happy
with the miso ramen just now♪

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...To be honest, I'm surprised.
I had no idea ramen was something
that could bring smiles to so many people's faces.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I totally get that feeling.
I was surprised by so many things
when I first came to Japan too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whether they want to cheer up
or reward themselves...
ramen puts a smile on those people's faces.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because I've rarely ever seen a place so content,
so natural, and filled with such pure happiness.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Everyone in the castle was always so crisp and disciplined, which was wonderful, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's a world we never would have known
if we'd just stayed inside the castle, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. For me, that might just be
a form of happiness I tend to overlook.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"We want to guide those precious to us toward happiness.
That is our wish. However――"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The little bit of happiness in a bowl of ramen
is a precious happiness for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In that case, don't you think there might be
even more things we can do?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For example—treating the person right in front of you
to a delicious bowl of ramen♪

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, that's true.
Perhaps I was rushing things a bit... in my eagerness to repay my debt of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"I must thank you—
because you made me realize something important."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Deciding to have ramen today,
I parted the shop's noren curtain and went in, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Welcooome!
...Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm helping out today.
How about a cup made with love, dear customer? ♪
choice_data_list: I think I'll order the tasty ramen
Those store clerk outfits look great on both of you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right away! In that case, please wait just a little longer—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'll prepare a drink that'll put a smile on your face♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that right♪
When it comes to love for ramen, I won't lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It's an unfamiliar outfit, yet refreshing. ...There is much to learn from the common folk.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then how about going on a ramen shop tour together next time?
It might help us understand the common folk better♪
